card.name: Modifier before toxic effect terms
card.fires_on: Adjectives or articles such as direct, broader, a and cardiac that sit right before a noun naming an effect or tissue action (toxic effect, effects, arrhythmias, affinity). Seen in overdose and toxicity passages.

modes.label: Direct effect
modes.description: The word direct before effect(s) when describing a drug's action on an organ.
modes.example: myocardial depression from the<< direct>> effects of bupivacaine may

modes.label: Cardiac before arrhythmias
modes.description: The word cardiac after accentuate, right before arrhythmias.
modes.example: hypokalemia may accentuate<< cardiac>> arrhythmias. In the event of

modes.label: Other qualifiers
modes.description: Small qualifiers like a or broader before an affinity or distribution term.
modes.example: 1. the quality of having<< a>> special affinity for nervous tissue.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about toxicity, harm and range of effect, such as toxic and spectrum.
card.plain: It marks a descriptive word just before the text names a harmful or tissue-specific effect of a drug.
